items.title: fix(cli): honor agent selection for image descriptions (#147456)
items.summary: fix(cli): honor agent selection for image descriptions (#147456) ## What Problem This Solves Image inference accepts `--agent`, discards the selected identity, and fails in explicit multi-agent fleets—even when the named agent exists. Supersedes #145188 by @MertBasar0. Reported in #145119 by @jarvis-stephens-bot. ## User Impact Image description works with the selected agent. Audio and video commands carry the same selected identity and retain their existing successful output behavior. ## Why This Change Was Made The decision which agent owns the operation stays with `resolveCapabilityProviderAgentId` in `src/cli/capability-cli/shared.ts`. All four CLI call sites now forward that decision alongside its credential directory. Tests check both values at the runtime boundary. Current audio evaluation order and provider/model output are preserved. ## Evidence With three explicit-owner agents and a synthetic loopback provider, the following commands failed before any HTTP request on main `4394ad538cac`. They succeed on `068dc9c759d9`: ```sh pnpm openclaw infer image describe --file image.png --prompt describe --agent finance --json pnpm openclaw infer image describe --file image.png --prompt describe --model stubvision/stub-vision-1 --agent finance --json pnpm openclaw infer image describe-many --file image.png --file image.png --prompt describe --agent finance --json ``` Sanitized terminal captures: ```text Before: exit 1; ok=false; AgentSelectionRequiredError; HTTP requests=0 After describe: exit 0; ok=true; SYNTHETIC_IMAGE_DESCRIPTION; requests=1 After explicit model: exit 0; ok=true; SYNTHETIC_IMAGE_DESCRIPTION; requests=1 After describe-many: exit 0; ok=true; two descriptions; requests=2 ``` The real Gateway passed its health check. These media commands use local transport. Sole-agent image, configured audio transcription, and configured video description succeed before and after; audio/video are consistency controls, not reproduced failures. The new registered-command assertions fail nine cases on trusted main `21aaac7ad6e7` and pass after the repair. On merge `e0665878861f` (parents `068dc9c759d9` and main `1692f891b167`), all five selected test files pass: **332 tests**. Validation commands and limits ```sh node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.cli.config.ts src/cli/capability-cli.test.ts --testNamePattern 'owner selection' node --import tsx scripts/ci-run-node-test-shard.mts pnpm openclaw infer audio transcribe --file audio.wav --agent finance --json pnpm openclaw infer video describe --file video.mp4 --agent finance --json ``` The CI test runner selected the full capability CLI, local account-secret, media runtime, settings-storage, and proxy lifecycle test files. CLI/account tests: 259; media runtime: 33; settings: 15; proxy: 25. An inherited color setting first affected the settings numeric-output assertion; disabling forced color passed without source or test changes. The successful owner/runtime suites were not repeated. Formatting, syntax lint, assertion safety, line limits, and unused-export checks pass. [CI run 34784959798](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34784959798) passed at `068dc9c759d99233ed17b668bef97b94ad10ab86`, including production and test typechecks. The original PR's settings failure was repaired upstream in #147029. Its old proxy child-exit failure remains unexplained; both exact tests passed in its matched main-parent CI. The current tests pass, but this does not waive fresh CI or declare the old proxy failure unrelated. **External SDK compatibility:** The same external consumer compiled and ran against the shipped 2026.9.4 package and the packaged candidate at `068dc9c759d9` in one isolated container. Directory-only and `agentId` calls passed for both audio and video: four successful calls per package, with the expected credential directory and loopback-only transport. ## Compatibility Audio/video SDK parameter types gain optional `agentId` fields. Existing directory-only callers remain valid. There is no new export, config key, schema, migration, protocol, or dependency. ## Consumers The selected agent identity and its credential directory now reach all four media CLI runtime calls. The existing runtime uses that identity for image model and workspace context. Audio and video retain their existing credential-directory behavior. The optional audio/video `agentId` fields extend the existing SDK parameter types. Existing directory-only callers remain valid. Browser screenshot description, sticker description, and voice transcription callers are unchanged; this PR does not claim to repair their separate identity-forwarding gaps. The three image command cases fail before any HTTP request on the recorded main baseline and succeed on the candidate. Configured audio/video and sole-agent image commands pass before and after. Automatic-selection cases were not executed. The media commands use local transport. The running Gateway is a health control. The 332 passing tests are the selected complete test files on the recorded fresh merge; full CI and typechecking passed in the exact-head run linked above. No cache or persisted state is added; existing account preparation and request cleanup keep their owners. Co-authored-by: MertBasar0 Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.summary: fix: resume interrupted work before new messages (#147486) Keep durable restart state with its recovery owner instead of consuming it during prompt preparation. Resume the interrupted turn through the existing Gateway recovery path before admitting new work, and direct the agent to reconcile current state and continue the original task.
